constraints.performance: The API needs to handle 100 requests/second per instance.
constraints.technology: Use Node.js with Express for the backend and integrate with existing authentication via auth/middleware.js. Utilize src/utils/dateValidation.js for date validation.
constraints.moduleBoundaries: Keep a separate Reminder entity/module and do not merge reminder-specific fields into the TODO model. Keep TODOs under src/todos/ and Reminders under src/reminders/.
constraints.deployment: The application will be deployed in a single-region without message queuing in version 1.

acceptanceCriteria.TODO_CRUD: Implement a REST API for creating, listing, marking as complete, and deleting TODO items.
acceptanceCriteria.ReminderFunctionality: Implement endpoints for creating and canceling reminders and ensure reminders verify authenticated requests using session validation methods. Validate reminder datetime in full ISO-8601 format before processing.
acceptanceCriteria.NotificationTiming: Ensure that reminders trigger a notification within 60 seconds of the scheduled time during integration testing.
acceptanceCriteria.Performance: Load test should sustain 100 requests/second for 60 seconds, with the 99th percentile latency under 200 milliseconds on standard hardware.

module_boundaries.todos: TODO CRUD only — no reminder-specific fields on the Todo model
module_boundaries.reminders: Separate Reminder entity/module for schedule + notify
